attributes.notes:
Kvil is an eating-schedule planner for adults. No account or sign-in is required.

Start with “Find my rhythm”, choose a usual daily window, then continue to Home. The schedule runs automatically; there are no start/stop controls or claims that a fast was completed. Home counts down until the next opening. During an open window it displays the window rather than a closing countdown.

Schedule supports a different window for each weekday, overnight windows, and a change just for today. Weekly edits start tomorrow. Optional opening/closing notifications are queued about four weeks ahead and renewed when the app runs; Settings displays the current horizon.

An optional reflection is offered after a window closes and the next day. Reflections describe the user's experience, not adherence. Seven days of reflections and the basic weekly recap are free. History > Explore full history presents the non-consumable dev.hkarlsen06.kvil.history, which unlocks older reflections and longer recaps. Restore Purchases is available in that screen and Settings. All artwork, schedules, reminders, weight logging, Apple Health, Watch, and widgets remain free.

Health is optional and limited to body weight. Enable weight in History or Settings. Reading Health and saving new Kvil measurements to Health are separate opt-ins; no Health permission is needed to use schedules. Kvil does not send Health data to a developer server.

The local SwiftData store does not use CloudKit. Only planned schedule preferences and dated schedule adjustments use iCloud key-value synchronization. Reflections, weight, and Health data are excluded from that payload and the Watch/widget snapshots. Local records are excluded from automatic device backup; Settings offers free JSON backup export/import and deletion.

The Watch receives the current schedule through WatchConnectivity and keeps calculating when the phone is unavailable. Open Kvil on the phone after setup, then open the Watch app. The phone owns notification delivery. Home and Lock Screen widgets open Kvil when tapped.

English and Norwegian Bokmål are included. The iPhone follows system light/dark appearance. The Watch uses a dark palette. Kvil has no advertising, third-party analytics, or tracking SDKs.
